rules.question: Are frontend components focused on one user-facing responsibility instead of accumulating unrelated flag combinations?
rules.applies_if: Frontend components or pages with multiple rendering branches or configuration flags

rules.question: Is client state owned at the narrowest appropriate scope without unnecessary global state or prop drilling?
rules.applies_if: Adding or changing state in frontend components

rules.question: Is derived UI state computed from source state instead of duplicated and synchronized separately?
rules.applies_if: Frontend state containing values derivable from other state or props

rules.question: Is shareable or navigation-sensitive UI state represented in the URL or browser history?
rules.applies_if: Filters, pagination, tabs, search, sorting, or views users expect to refresh, bookmark, or revisit

rules.question: Are stale or out-of-order asynchronous responses prevented from overwriting newer UI state?
rules.applies_if: Search, autocomplete, route changes, polling, or concurrent frontend requests

rules.question: Are event listeners, timers, observers, subscriptions, and asynchronous effects cleaned up or safely ignored after their owner unmounts or disconnects?
rules.applies_if: Frontend effects, DOM controllers, subscriptions, timers, observers, or fetch requests tied to component or route lifecycle

rules.question: Are loading, empty, success, and recoverable error states represented for asynchronous UI?
rules.applies_if: Frontend views that load or mutate remote data

rules.question: Are optimistic UI changes reconciled with server truth after failure or conflict?
rules.applies_if: Optimistic updates or client-first mutations of remote data

rules.question: Does core content or functionality remain usable when optional JavaScript or a newer browser API is unavailable?
rules.applies_if: Progressive enhancement, client-rendered content, forms, navigation, or newer browser APIs

rules.question: Does the responsive layout avoid horizontal overflow and preserve content at supported viewport sizes?
rules.applies_if: Responsive layouts, fixed-width elements, or viewport-specific styles

rules.question: Do images reserve their rendered space before loading by providing intrinsic dimensions or an equivalent aspect ratio?
rules.applies_if: Adding or changing rendered images, media cards, avatars, or galleries

rules.question: Do images use responsive sources and loading priority appropriate to their rendered size and position?
rules.applies_if: Responsive images, image-heavy pages, or above-the-fold media

rules.question: Does the change avoid introducing unexpected layout shifts from asynchronous content, fonts, or media?
rules.applies_if: Dynamic rendering, deferred data, web fonts, ads, embeds, or media loading

rules.question: Are third-party scripts loaded only when needed and kept out of the critical rendering path?
rules.applies_if: Analytics, advertising, embeds, widgets, or other third-party frontend scripts

rules.question: Are expensive interaction handlers and rendering tasks kept from blocking the browser main thread?
rules.applies_if: Large event handlers, synchronous parsing, client-side computation, or heavy rendering work

rules.question: Are authentication tokens, session identifiers, and credentials kept out of Web Storage and client bundles?
rules.applies_if: Frontend authentication, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, or public build configuration

rules.question: Are cross-window messages checked against exact allowed origins and an expected data shape before use?
rules.applies_if: postMessage, MessageChannel, iframe communication, or cross-window events

rules.question: Are browser APIs and newer platform features guarded by feature detection or an explicit support baseline?
rules.applies_if: Using browser APIs, CSS features, or platform capabilities with uneven support

rules.question: Do pending form submissions prevent ambiguous duplicate interaction and preserve a recoverable state?
rules.applies_if: Forms or buttons that trigger asynchronous mutations

rules.question: Are every side-effecting UI effect's early-return, success, failure, cancellation, and unmount paths paired with the required cleanup?
rules.applies_if: React effects, Stimulus/Turbo controllers, injected scripts, global listeners, timers, or DOM mutations

rules.question: Do DOM callbacks and asynchronous completions verify that their owning component or controller is still current before mutating UI?
rules.applies_if: React remounts, Turbo page swaps, Stimulus disconnects, route changes, or delayed UI callbacks

rules.question: Does concurrent UI interaction state use an explicit model that prevents impossible combinations and duplicate in-flight work?
rules.applies_if: Overlapping clicks, async mutations, timers, animations, or UI state represented by multiple booleans

rules.question: Are event handlers lifecycle-safe, using delegation when repeated per-element wiring would multiply teardown or duplicate-trigger risk?
rules.applies_if: Dynamic lists, repeated DOM elements, or components attaching handlers to many child nodes
